schema.text: Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scooter because it costs too much (fuel, parking, insurance)?

ar.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: هل تعود قلّة ركوبك الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر إلى أنها مكلفة جدًا (الوقود، المواقف، التأمين)؟

de.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Fahren Sie selten Motorrad oder Roller, weil es zu teuer ist (Kraftstoff, Parken, Versicherung)?

en.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scooter because it costs too much (fuel, parking, insurance)?

fa.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: آیا کم موتورسواری می‌کنید چون خیلی گران تمام می‌شود (سوخت، پارکینگ، بیمه)؟

fr.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Utilisez-vous rarement une moto ou un scooter parce que cela coûte trop cher (carburant, stationnement, assurance) ?

hu.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Azért motorozik vagy robogózik ritkán, mert túl drága (üzemanyag, parkolás, biztosítás)?

it.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Usi poco la moto o lo scooter perché costa troppo (carburante, parcheggio, assicurazione)?

tr.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Çok pahalı olduğu için mi (yakıt, otopark, sigorta) nadiren motosiklet veya skuter kullanıyorsunuz?
